kind_note: reinforcement learning system for solving the Kissing Number Problem
note: PackingStar is a reinforcement learning system developed by researchers from Peking University (led by Chengdong Ma), Fudan University, and Shanghai Academy of AI for Science. It solves the Kissing Number Problem by reformulating it as a game-theoretic matrix completion game. The system first became publicly available as an arXiv preprint on November 17, 2025, with the GitHub repository (github.com/CDM1619/PackingStar) also released around that time.
